answer: Every claimant must first become a vertex: three established peers sign receipts proving they exchanged signed packets with it on two separate days. Nectar drips to a vertex only after those receipts verify. Each round the Zephyr beacon broadcasts a fresh nonce and the vertex must echo it, signed, within 300 ms from its own path; verifiers reject any batch whose echoes share one path. A farm must recruit three established peers per puppet and pay attestation each time, with no bulk discount, so cost scales with N while an honest agent pays once.
